market_outlook.short_term: Markets face a difficult 1-3 month window: $100 oil + trade war escalation + sticky rates create stagflationary pressure. Energy and defense outperform; consumer and long-duration bonds underperform. Bessent's FX intervention adds volatility. US CPI print is the critical near-term catalyst. Expect elevated VIX (18-25 range).
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook is cautiously constructive if Iran conflict de-escalates and trade wars stabilize. AI capex cycle (TSMC, Entegris) and banking consolidation (EverBank-WaFd, Millennium) provide structural growth. However, Japan repatriation and persistent energy costs cap upside. Base case: S&P 500 +5-8% over 12 months; energy +15%; semis +12%; consumer -3%.
